type Deep<T> = { v: T; next?: Deep<T[]> };
function fa(a: Deep<string>): void {
  const b: Deep<number> = a;
}
interface Box<T> {
  v: T;
  wrap(): Box<Box<T>>;
}
function fb(bs: Box<string>): void {
  const bn: Box<number> = bs;
}
type List<T> = { head: T; tail: List<T> | undefined };
function fl(l: List<string>): void {
  const ln: List<number> = l;
}
type Tree = { children: Tree[]; label: string };
type Tree2 = { children: Tree2[]; label: number };
function ft(t: Tree): void {
  const t2: Tree2 = t;
}
type Nest<T> = { inner: Nest<{ x: T }> | T };
function fn(ns: Nest<string>): void {
  const nn: Nest<number> = ns;
}
type Grow<T> = { more: Grow<[T]>; last: T };
function fg(g: Grow<string>): void {
  const gn: Grow<number> = g;
  const gu: Grow<string | number> = g;
}
console.log(fa, fb, fl, ft, fn, fg);
